```{r setup}
## 1. Open and inspect the EMEP4UK 2024 file

library(terra)
library(ncdf4)

# Find the folder containing this R Markdown file
rmd_path <- if (rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
  rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path
} else {
  ""
}

if (!nzchar(rmd_path) && requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  rmd_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
}

if (!nzchar(rmd_path)) {
  stop(
    "Save and open EMEP4UK_SIA_analysis.Rmd before running this code."
  )
}

analysis_dir <- dirname(rmd_path)
processed_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "processed_data")
figures_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "figures")

dir.create(processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(2024)

# Location of the downloaded NetCDF file
emep_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "raw_data",
  "EMEP4UK_met2024_emis2023.nc"
)

if (!file.exists(emep_file)) {
  stop("EMEP4UK file not found:\n", emep_file)
}

cat(
  "File found:", basename(emep_file),
  "\nFile size:", round(file.info(emep_file)$size / 1e9, 2), "GB\n"
)

# Limit terra's memory use and create a temporary working folder
terra_temp <- file.path(
  processed_dir,
  "terra_temp"
)

dir.create(
  terra_temp,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.5,
  tempdir = terra_temp,
  progress = 1
)

# Read only the NetCDF header to identify available variables
nc <- nc_open(
  emep_file,
  readunlim = FALSE
)

available_variables <- names(nc$var)

nc_close(nc)
rm(nc)

# Variables relevant to the analysis
variables_needed <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",  # total PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_SIA",        # secondary inorganic aerosol
  "SURF_ug_NH4_F",      # particulate ammonium
  "SURF_ug_NO3_F",      # fine particulate nitrate
  "SURF_ug_SO4",        # particulate sulfate
  "SURF_ug_PPM25",      # primary PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_NH3",        # gaseous ammonia
  "HMIX",               # mixing-layer height
  "WDEP_PREC"            # precipitation
)

variable_check <- data.frame(
  variable = variables_needed,
  available = variables_needed %in% available_variables
)

print(variable_check, row.names = FALSE)

# Stop if the two essential variables are missing
essential_variables <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

if (!all(essential_variables %in% available_variables)) {
  stop("An essential PM2.5 or SIA variable is missing.")
}

# Open only total PM2.5 and SIA
# The values remain stored in the NetCDF file, not loaded into RAM
pm25_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50"
)

sia_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

# Check the resulting objects
print(pm25_2024)
print(sia_2024)

cat(
  "\nNumber of daily SIA layers:", nlyr(sia_2024),
  "\nSpatial resolution:", paste(res(sia_2024), collapse = " × "),
  "\nValues currently held in RAM:", inMemory(sia_2024),
  "\n"
)

print(range(time(sia_2024)))

# Display the first daily SIA map
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = "EMEP4UK secondary inorganic aerosol: first day"
)
```

```{r aurn-sites}
## 2. Select AURN background locations for PM2.5 validation

background_types <- c(
  "Urban Background",
  "Suburban Background",
  "Rural Background"
)

# Import complete AURN metadata
aurn_meta_2024 <- openair::importMeta(
  source = "aurn",
  all = TRUE,
  year = 2024
)

# Standardise column names
names(aurn_meta_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", names(aurn_meta_2024))

# Select background locations measuring PM2.5 during 2024
aurn_sites_2024 <- aurn_meta_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^PM2\\.5", variable, ignore.case = TRUE),
    site_type %in% background_types,
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Convert locations to the EMEP projection
aurn_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  aurn_sites_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(sia_2024))

cat("Selected AURN locations:", nrow(aurn_sites_2024), "\n")
print(table(aurn_sites_2024$site_type))

# Plot modelled SIA with AURN validation locations
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = paste(
    "EMEP4UK modelled SIA with selected",
    "AURN background monitoring locations",
    "1 January 2024",
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  plg = list(title = "SIA (ug/m3)")
)

plot(
  aurn_points_2024,
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 21,
  bg = "#E57200",
  col = "white",
  cex = 0.8
)
```

```{r aurn-emep-extraction}

## 3. Extract daily EMEP4UK values at AURN locations

pm25_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  pm25_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

sia_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  sia_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

aurn_emep_2024 <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  code = aurn_sites_2024$code,
  date = as.Date(terra::time(pm25_2024))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    emep_pm25_rh50 = as.vector(t(as.matrix(pm25_at_aurn))),
    emep_sia = as.vector(t(as.matrix(sia_at_aurn))),
    sia_percent_pm25 = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25_rh50 > 0,
      100 * emep_sia / emep_pm25_rh50,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_sites_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        site,
        site_type,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "code"
  )

saveRDS(
  aurn_emep_2024,
  file.path(processed_dir, "aurn_emep_2024.rds")
)

cat(
  "Rows:", nrow(aurn_emep_2024),
  "\nSites:", dplyr::n_distinct(aurn_emep_2024$code),
  "\nDates:", paste(range(aurn_emep_2024$date), collapse = " to "),
  "\nMissing PM2.5:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_pm25_rh50)),
  "\nMissing SIA:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_sia)),
  "\n"
)
```
```{r aurn-import}
## 4. Import measured AURN PM2.5 and calculate daily means

aurn_hourly_2024 <- openair::importAURN(
  site = aurn_sites_2024$code,
  year = 2024
) |>
  dplyr::select(
    code,
    site,
    date,
    `pm2.5`
  )

# Calculate annual hourly data capture for each site
aurn_capture_2024 <- aurn_hourly_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(code, site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    valid_hours = sum(!is.na(`pm2.5`)),
    capture_percent = 100 * valid_hours / (366 * 24),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

valid_aurn_sites_2024 <- aurn_capture_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(capture_percent >= 75)

# Calculate daily means requiring at least 75% hourly coverage
aurn_daily_2024 <- openair::timeAverage(
  aurn_hourly_2024,
  avg.time = "day",
  statistic = "mean",
  data.thresh = 75,
  type = c("site", "code"),
  interval = "hour"
) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    site,
    date = as.Date(date),
    aurn_pm25 = `pm2.5`
  ) |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    valid_aurn_sites_2024,
    by = c("code", "site")
  )

saveRDS(
  aurn_daily_2024,
  file.path(processed_dir, "aurn_daily_pm25_2024.rds")
)

cat(
  "Imported sites:", dplyr::n_distinct(aurn_hourly_2024$code),
  "\nSites with at least 75% annual capture:",
  nrow(valid_aurn_sites_2024),
  "\nDaily records:", nrow(aurn_daily_2024),
  "\nDate range:",
  paste(range(aurn_daily_2024$date), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r aurn-validation}
## 5. Match AURN observations with EMEP4UK and calculate annual means

duplicate_aurn_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(aurn_daily_2024[c("code", "date")])
)

duplicate_emep_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(aurn_emep_2024[c("code", "date")])
)

if (duplicate_aurn_keys > 0 || duplicate_emep_keys > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate site-date keys detected before joining.")
}

# Join measured and modelled daily concentrations
aurn_emep_matched_all_2024 <- aurn_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_emep_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        date,
        emep_pm25_rh50,
        emep_sia
      ),
    by = c("code", "date")
  )

unmatched_model_rows <- sum(
  is.na(aurn_emep_matched_all_2024$emep_pm25_rh50)
)

# Retain complete measured-modelled daily pairs
aurn_emep_matched_2024 <- aurn_emep_matched_all_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(aurn_pm25),
    !is.na(emep_pm25_rh50),
    !is.na(emep_sia)
  )

# Calculate annual means at each AURN location
aurn_emep_annual_all_2024 <- aurn_emep_matched_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(code, site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    matched_days = dplyr::n(),
    paired_capture_percent = 100 * matched_days / 366,
    aurn_pm25_annual = mean(aurn_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    emep_pm25_annual = mean(emep_pm25_rh50, na.rm = TRUE),
    emep_sia_annual = mean(emep_sia, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sia_percent_annual =
      100 * emep_sia_annual / emep_pm25_annual
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_sites_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        site_type,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "code"
  )

# Require at least 75% paired daily coverage
aurn_emep_annual_2024 <- aurn_emep_annual_all_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(paired_capture_percent >= 75)

# Evaluate annual EMEP PM2.5 against measured AURN PM2.5
annual_validation_stats_2024 <- openair::modStats(
  aurn_emep_annual_2024,
  obs = "aurn_pm25_annual",
  mod = "emep_pm25_annual"
)

validation_output_2024 <- list(
  daily_matched = aurn_emep_matched_2024,
  annual_site_means = aurn_emep_annual_2024,
  model_statistics = annual_validation_stats_2024
)

saveRDS(
  validation_output_2024,
  file.path(processed_dir, "aurn_emep_validation_2024.rds")
)

cat(
  "Duplicate AURN keys:", duplicate_aurn_keys,
  "\nDuplicate EMEP keys:", duplicate_emep_keys,
  "\nAURN records without an EMEP match:", unmatched_model_rows,
  "\nComplete matched site-days:", nrow(aurn_emep_matched_2024),
  "\nSites retained:", nrow(aurn_emep_annual_2024),
  "\nMatched-day range:",
  paste(range(aurn_emep_annual_2024$matched_days), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)

print(annual_validation_stats_2024)
```

```{r aurn-validation-plot}
## 6. Plot annual EMEP4UK validation against AURN observations

annual_validation_plot_2024 <- openair::scatterPlot(

annual_validation_plot_2024
```

```{r samhe-preparation}
## 7. Load SAMHE data and prepare 2024 school summaries

project_dir <- dirname(dirname(analysis_dir))

core_files <- c(
  file.path(project_dir, "analysis_core_objects.RData"),
  file.path(
    project_dir,
    "SAMHE_core_files",
    "analysis_core_objects.RData"
  )
)

core_files <- core_files[file.exists(core_files)]

if (length(core_files) == 0) {
  stop("analysis_core_objects.RData could not be found.")
}

core_environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(core_files[1], envir = core_environment)

required_core_objects <- c("In_Out_24", "df_school_chars")
missing_core_objects <- setdiff(
  required_core_objects,
  ls(core_environment)
)

if (length(missing_core_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing core object(s): ",
    paste(missing_core_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

required_in_out_columns <- c(
  "SchoolId_short",
  "DateTime",
  "pm02",
  "pm2.5"
)

missing_in_out_columns <- setdiff(
  required_in_out_columns,
  names(core_environment$In_Out_24)
)

if (length(missing_in_out_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing In_Out_24 column(s): ",
    paste(missing_in_out_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

df_school_chars <- core_environment$df_school_chars

datetime_tz <- attr(
  core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime,
  "tzone"
)

if (is.null(datetime_tz) || !nzchar(datetime_tz)) {
  datetime_tz <- "UTC"
}

start_2024 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2024-01-01 00:00:00",
  tz = datetime_tz
)

end_2024 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2025-01-01 00:00:00",
  tz = datetime_tz
)

# Preserve the existing SAMHE exclusions; only restrict the period to 2024
In_Out_24_2024 <- core_environment$In_Out_24[
  core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime >= start_2024 &
    core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime < end_2024,
  required_in_out_columns
]

rm(core_environment)
invisible(gc())

# Create one validated coordinate pair per school
school_locations_2024 <- df_school_chars |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short),
    latitude = as.numeric(SchoolLatitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(SchoolLongitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(SchoolId_short),
    is.finite(latitude),
    is.finite(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

if (anyDuplicated(school_locations_2024$SchoolId_short)) {
  stop("Some schools have more than one coordinate pair.")
}

mean_available <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Retain the established SAMHE annual calculation
samhe_annual_2024 <- In_Out_24_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    indoor_pm25_mean = mean_available(pm02),
    outdoor_pm25_mean = mean_available(`pm2.5`),
    n_observations = dplyr::n(),
    n_days = dplyr::n_distinct(as.Date(DateTime)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create one SAMHE/AURN value per school and observed day
samhe_daily_2024 <- In_Out_24_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short),
    date = as.Date(DateTime)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short, date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean_available(pm02),
    aurn_pm25 = mean_available(`pm2.5`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

analysis_school_locations_2024 <- school_locations_2024 |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    samhe_annual_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  )

analysis_school_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  analysis_school_locations_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(pm25_2024))

cat(
  "SAMHE schools:", nrow(samhe_annual_2024),
  "\nObserved-day range:",
  paste(range(samhe_annual_2024$n_days), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r school-emep-daily}
## 8. Extract or load daily EMEP4UK components at SAMHE schools

daily_variables_2024 <- c(
  emep_pm25 = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  emep_sia_total = "SURF_ug_SIA",
  emep_nh4 = "SURF_ug_NH4_F",
  emep_no3_f = "SURF_ug_NO3_F",
  emep_no3_c = "SURF_ug_NO3_C",
  emep_so4 = "SURF_ug_SO4"
)

if (!all(daily_variables_2024 %in% available_variables)) {
  stop("One or more required EMEP4UK variables are missing.")
}

model_dates_2024 <- as.Date(terra::time(pm25_2024))

school_emep_daily_file <- file.path(
  processed_dir,
  "school_emep_daily_2024.rds"
)

build_school_emep_daily <- function() {

  extract_daily_variable <- function(variable) {

    message("Extracting ", variable)

    raster <- terra::rast(
      emep_file,
      subds = variable
    )

    if (!identical(
      as.Date(terra::time(raster)),
      model_dates_2024
    )) {
      stop("The EMEP4UK dates do not match for ", variable)
    }

    values <- terra::extract(
      raster,
      analysis_school_points_2024,
      ID = FALSE
    )

    as.vector(t(as.matrix(values)))
  }

  daily_values <- lapply(
    daily_variables_2024,
    extract_daily_variable
  )

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    tidyr::expand_grid(
      SchoolId_short =
        analysis_school_locations_2024$SchoolId_short,
      date = model_dates_2024
    ),
    tibble::as_tibble(daily_values)
  )
}

rebuild_emep_cache <- TRUE

if (file.exists(school_emep_daily_file)) {
  cached_school_emep <- readRDS(school_emep_daily_file)

  cache_columns_ok <- all(
    c(
      "SchoolId_short",
      "date",
      names(daily_variables_2024)
    ) %in% names(cached_school_emep)
  )

  cache_dates_ok <- cache_columns_ok && identical(
    sort(unique(as.Date(cached_school_emep$date))),
    model_dates_2024
  )

  cache_schools_ok <- cache_columns_ok && setequal(
    unique(as.character(cached_school_emep$SchoolId_short)),
    analysis_school_locations_2024$SchoolId_short
  )

  if (cache_columns_ok && cache_dates_ok && cache_schools_ok) {
    school_emep_daily_2024 <- cached_school_emep
    rebuild_emep_cache <- FALSE
    message("Loaded cached daily EMEP4UK school data.")
  }

  rm(cached_school_emep)
}

if (rebuild_emep_cache) {
  school_emep_daily_2024 <- build_school_emep_daily()
  saveRDS(school_emep_daily_2024, school_emep_daily_file)
}

# Recalculate derived components even when the extraction is loaded from cache
school_emep_daily_2024 <- school_emep_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short),
    date = as.Date(date),
    fine_sia = emep_nh4 + emep_no3_f + emep_so4,
    reconstructed_total_sia = fine_sia + emep_no3_c,
    total_sia_closure = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_sia_total > 0,
      100 * reconstructed_total_sia / emep_sia_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    fine_sia_percent_pm25 = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25 > 0,
      100 * fine_sia / emep_pm25,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

daily_fine_sia_2024 <- samhe_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    school_emep_daily_2024,
    by = c("SchoolId_short", "date")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(indoor_pm25),
    is.finite(aurn_pm25),
    is.finite(emep_pm25),
    is.finite(fine_sia)
  )

school_coverage_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::count(
    SchoolId_short,
    name = "complete_days"
  )

saveRDS(
  daily_fine_sia_2024,
  file.path(processed_dir, "daily_fine_sia_2024.rds")
)

cat(
  "Complete school-days:", nrow(daily_fine_sia_2024),
  "\nSchools:",
  dplyr::n_distinct(daily_fine_sia_2024$SchoolId_short),
  "\nDuplicate school-dates:",
  sum(duplicated(
    daily_fine_sia_2024[c("SchoolId_short", "date")]
  )),
  "\nSchools with at least 90 complete days:",
  sum(school_coverage_2024$complete_days >= 90),
  "\n"
)

# These large source objects are no longer needed downstream
rm(In_Out_24_2024, samhe_daily_2024)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r annual-primary}
## 9. Create the definitive annual analysis dataset

# Preserve the established ≥90 complete-day SAMHE cohort
schools_90_days_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::count(SchoolId_short, name = "complete_days") |>
  dplyr::filter(complete_days >= 90)

# Calculate annual EMEP4UK values from all 366 modelled days
emep_annual_fine_2024 <- school_emep_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    model_days = sum(
      complete.cases(
        emep_pm25,
        emep_sia_total,
        emep_nh4,
        emep_no3_f,
        emep_no3_c,
        emep_so4
      )
    ),
    emep_pm25_annual = mean(emep_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    fine_sia_annual = mean(fine_sia, na.rm = TRUE),
    nitrate_annual = mean(emep_no3_f, na.rm = TRUE),
    sulfate_annual = mean(emep_so4, na.rm = TRUE),
    ammonium_annual = mean(emep_nh4, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_sia_annual = mean(emep_sia_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    reconstructed_sia_annual =
      mean(reconstructed_total_sia, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Ratio of annual means—not the mean of daily percentages
    fine_sia_percent_annual =
      100 * fine_sia_annual / emep_pm25_annual,

    nitrate_share_annual =
      100 * nitrate_annual / fine_sia_annual,

    sulfate_share_annual =
      100 * sulfate_annual / fine_sia_annual,

    ammonium_share_annual =
      100 * ammonium_annual / fine_sia_annual,

    pm25_without_fine_sia =
      emep_pm25_annual - fine_sia_annual,

    total_sia_closure =
      100 * reconstructed_sia_annual / total_sia_annual
  )

# Join the annual model results to the established SAMHE summaries
annual_primary_2024 <- schools_90_days_2024 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    samhe_annual_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    emep_annual_fine_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    model_days == length(model_dates_2024),
    complete.cases(
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      emep_pm25_annual,
      fine_sia_annual
    )
  )

# Concise validation summary
annual_primary_summary_2024 <- annual_primary_2024 |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    schools = dplyr::n(),
    model_days_min = min(model_days),
    model_days_max = max(model_days),
    samhe_days_min = min(complete_days),
    samhe_days_max = max(complete_days),
    median_modelled_pm25 = median(emep_pm25_annual),
    median_fine_sia = median(fine_sia_annual),
    median_fine_sia_percent =
      median(fine_sia_percent_annual),
    schools_above_who_5 =
      sum(emep_pm25_annual > 5),
    percent_above_who_5 =
      100 * mean(emep_pm25_annual > 5),
    median_component_closure =
      median(total_sia_closure)
  )

annual_primary_summary_2024
saveRDS(
  annual_primary_2024,
  file.path(processed_dir, "annual_primary_2024.rds")
)
```

```{r annual-relationship}
## 10. Summarise annual fine-SIA composition and indoor relationship

# Add complete-day coverage to the validated annual EMEP4UK values
annual_fine_sia_all_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::count(
    SchoolId_short,
    name = "complete_days"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    samhe_annual_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        SchoolId_short,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        outdoor_pm25_mean
      ),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    emep_annual_fine_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  )

# Primary ≥90-day cohort
annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024 <- annual_primary_2024

fine_sia_annual_summary_2024 <-
  annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024 |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    schools = dplyr::n(),
    median_fine_sia = median(fine_sia_annual),
    median_fine_sia_percent =
      median(fine_sia_percent_annual),
    median_nitrate_share =
      median(nitrate_share_annual),
    median_sulfate_share =
      median(sulfate_share_annual),
    median_ammonium_share =
      median(ammonium_share_annual),
    median_total_sia_closure =
      median(total_sia_closure)
  )

# Check whether the annual relationship changes with coverage
annual_fine_sia_sensitivity_2024 <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c(1, 30, 90),
    function(minimum_days) {

      results <- annual_fine_sia_all_2024 |>
        dplyr::filter(
          complete_days >= minimum_days,
          is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
          is.finite(fine_sia_annual)
        )

      pearson <- stats::cor.test(
        results$fine_sia_annual,
        results$indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "pearson"
      )

      spearman <- stats::cor.test(
        results$fine_sia_annual,
        results$indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        minimum_days = minimum_days,
        schools = nrow(results),
        pearson_r = unname(pearson$estimate),
        r_squared = unname(pearson$estimate)^2,
        pearson_p = pearson$p.value,
        spearman_rho = unname(spearman$estimate),
        spearman_p = spearman$p.value
      )
    }
  )

fine_sia_annual_plot_2024 <- openair::scatterPlot(
  annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024,
  x = "fine_sia_annual",
  y = "indoor_pm25_mean",
  z = "complete_days",
  linear = TRUE,
  ci = TRUE,
  cols = "viridis",
  key.title = "Complete days",
  auto.text = FALSE,
  xlab = "EMEP4UK annual mean fine SIA (µg/m³)",
  ylab = paste(
    "SAMHE 2024 mean indoor PM2.5",
    "from available valid observations (µg/m³)"
  ),
  title = "Annual fine SIA and indoor PM2.5 at SAMHE schools",
  subtitle = paste(
    nrow(annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024),
    "schools with at least 90 complete matched days;",
    "EMEP4UK means use all 366 modelled days"
  )
)

fine_sia_annual_summary_2024
annual_fine_sia_sensitivity_2024
print(fine_sia_annual_plot_2024$plot)
```

```{r observed-day-sensitivity}
    by = "SchoolId_short"

summarise_sia_relationship <- function(
    data,
    period_name,
    sia_column,
    percentage_column
) {

  pearson <- stats::cor.test(
    data[[sia_column]],
    data$indoor_pm25_mean,
    method = "pearson"
  )

  spearman <- stats::cor.test(
    data[[sia_column]],
    data$indoor_pm25_mean,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    model_period = period_name,
    schools = nrow(data),
    median_fine_sia =
      median(data[[sia_column]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_fine_sia_percent =
      median(data[[percentage_column]], na.rm = TRUE),
    pearson_r = unname(pearson$estimate),
    r_squared = unname(pearson$estimate)^2,
    pearson_p = pearson$p.value,
    spearman_rho = unname(spearman$estimate),
    spearman_p = spearman$p.value
  )
}

observed_day_sensitivity_summary_2024 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_sia_relationship(
    observed_day_sensitivity_2024,
    "All 366 modelled days",
    "fine_sia_annual",
    "fine_sia_percent_annual"
  ),
  summarise_sia_relationship(
    observed_day_sensitivity_2024,
    "School-observed days",
    "observed_fine_sia",
    "observed_fine_sia_percent"
  )
)
```

```{r episode-analysis}
## 12. Compare high fine-SIA days with other observed days

fine_episode_daily_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::select(
    SchoolId_short,
    date,
    fine_sia,
    aurn_pm25,
    indoor_pm25
  )

# Define high days separately for each school
fine_episode_school_2024 <-
  fine_episode_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_days = dplyr::n(),

    high_fine_sia =
      fine_sia >=
      stats::quantile(
        fine_sia,
        0.90
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_days =
      dplyr::first(n_days),

    fine_sia_change =
      mean(fine_sia[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(fine_sia[!high_fine_sia]),

    aurn_change =
      mean(aurn_pm25[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(aurn_pm25[!high_fine_sia]),

    indoor_change =
      mean(indoor_pm25[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(indoor_pm25[!high_fine_sia]),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

episode_sensitivity_fine_2024 <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c(2, 30, 90),
    function(minimum_days) {

      results <- fine_episode_school_2024 |>
        dplyr::filter(
          n_days >= minimum_days
        )

      tibble::tibble(
        minimum_days = minimum_days,
        schools = nrow(results),

        median_fine_sia_change =
          median(results$fine_sia_change),

        median_aurn_change =
          median(results$aurn_change),

        median_indoor_change =
          median(results$indoor_change),

        schools_indoor_higher_percent =
          100 *
          mean(results$indoor_change > 0),

        wilcoxon_p =
          stats::wilcox.test(
            results$indoor_change,
            mu = 0,
            exact = FALSE
          )$p.value
      )
    }
  )

print(episode_sensitivity_fine_2024)
```

```{r}
## 19. Map annual secondary inorganic aerosol and indoor PM2.5

annual_sia_file_2024 <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "processed_data",
  "annual_fine_sia_mean_2024.tif"
)

dir.create(
  dirname(annual_sia_file_2024),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Create the annual modelled aerosol raster once, then reuse it
if (file.exists(annual_sia_file_2024)) {

  annual_fine_sia_raster_2024 <-
    terra::rast(annual_sia_file_2024)

} else {

  read_annual_component_mean <- function(variable) {

    raster <- terra::rast(
      emep_file,
      subds = variable
    )

    if (terra::nlyr(raster) != 366) {
      stop(variable, " does not contain 366 daily layers.")
    }

    terra::app(
      raster,
      fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  annual_nh4_mean_2024 <-
    read_annual_component_mean("SURF_ug_NH4_F")

  annual_no3_mean_2024 <-
    read_annual_component_mean("SURF_ug_NO3_F")

  annual_so4_mean_2024 <-
    read_annual_component_mean("SURF_ug_SO4")

  annual_fine_sia_raster_2024 <-
    annual_nh4_mean_2024 +
    annual_no3_mean_2024 +
    annual_so4_mean_2024

  names(annual_fine_sia_raster_2024) <- "fine_sia"

  terra::writeRaster(
    annual_fine_sia_raster_2024,
    annual_sia_file_2024,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  rm(
  annual_sia_file_2024,
  annual_fine_sia_raster_2024,
  uk_bbox,
  annual_map_extent
  )

invisible(gc())
}
```

```{r november-episode-map}
## 18. Map the 4–8 November fine-SIA episode and indoor response

november_episode_dates <- seq(
  as.Date("2024-11-04"),
  as.Date("2024-11-08"),
  by = "day"
)

# Read only the required dates from each fine-SIA component
read_episode_component <- function(variable) {

  raster <- terra::rast(
    emep_file,
    subds = variable
  )

  episode_layers <- which(
    as.Date(terra::time(raster)) %in%
      november_episode_dates
  )

  if (length(episode_layers) != length(november_episode_dates)) {
    stop("Not all November episode dates were found.")
  }

  raster[[episode_layers]]
}

episode_nh4_2024 <- read_episode_component("SURF_ug_NH4_F")
episode_no3_2024 <- read_episode_component("SURF_ug_NO3_F")
episode_so4_2024 <- read_episode_component("SURF_ug_SO4")

# Mean fine SIA across 4–8 November
november_fine_sia_raster_2024 <- terra::app(
  episode_nh4_2024 +
    episode_no3_2024 +
    episode_so4_2024,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

    ),
    other_indoor_pm25 = mean(
      indoor_pm25[!date %in% november_episode_dates],
      na.rm = TRUE

    indoor_change =
      episode_indoor_pm25 - other_indoor_pm25,
```

```{r contextual-association-tests}

## 23. Test associations with the annual indoor/outdoor PM2.5 ratio

context_test_data_2024 <- annual_context_analysis_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    PercentageFSM_numeric = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(PercentageFSM),
      na = c("", "NA", "c")
    ),

    FloorArea_numeric = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(FloorArea),
      na = c("", "NA")
    ),

    RUC_group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("^\\s*urban", RUC, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Urban",
      grepl("^\\s*rural", RUC, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::add_count(
    BuildingEnvironment,
    name = "building_environment_n"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    BuildingEnvironment_group = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(BuildingEnvironment) &
        building_environment_n >= 5,
      as.character(BuildingEnvironment),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

numeric_context_variables_2024 <- c(
  "SchoolBuildingAge",
  "IMD_decile",
  "PercentageFSM_numeric",
  "FractionalOccupancy",
  "FloorArea_numeric"
)

context_numeric_results_2024 <- purrr::map_dfr(
  numeric_context_variables_2024,
  function(variable_name) {

    test_data <- context_test_data_2024 |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        contextual_value = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(as.character(.data[[variable_name]]))
        ),
        annual_io_ratio
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        is.finite(contextual_value),
        is.finite(annual_io_ratio)
      )

    test_result <- stats::cor.test(
      test_data$contextual_value,
      test_data$annual_io_ratio,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )

    tibble::tibble(
      variable = sub("_numeric$", "", variable_name),
      method = "Spearman correlation",
      schools = nrow(test_data),
      groups = NA_integer_,
      statistic = unname(test_result$estimate),
      p_value = test_result$p.value
    )
  }
)

categorical_context_variables_2024 <- c(
  "RUC_group",
  "BuildingEnvironment_group"
)

context_categorical_results_2024 <- purrr::map_dfr(
  categorical_context_variables_2024,
  function(variable_name) {

    test_data <- context_test_data_2024 |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        contextual_group = .data[[variable_name]],
        annual_io_ratio
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(contextual_group),
        is.finite(annual_io_ratio)
      )

    test_result <- stats::kruskal.test(
      annual_io_ratio ~ contextual_group,
      data = test_data
    )

    tibble::tibble(
      variable = sub("_group$", "", variable_name),
      method = "Kruskal-Wallis",
      schools = nrow(test_data),
      groups = dplyr::n_distinct(test_data$contextual_group),
      statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
      p_value = test_result$p.value
    )
  }
)

context_association_results_2024 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  context_numeric_results_2024,
  context_categorical_results_2024
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    adjusted_p = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

context_association_results_2024

```

```{r save-and-clean, eval=FALSE}
## 24. Save essential objects and remove intermediates

# Optional: run this chunk manually after all previous chunks have completed.
# It is not evaluated during knitting because it deliberately cleans GlobalEnv.
essential_object_names_2024 <- c(
  "analysis_dir",
  "processed_dir",
  "figures_dir",
  "project_dir",
  "emep_file",
  "pm25_2024",
  "sia_2024",
  "df_school_chars",
  "school_locations_2024",
  "analysis_school_locations_2024",
  "aurn_emep_annual_2024",
  "annual_validation_stats_2024",
  "samhe_annual_2024",
  "school_emep_daily_2024",
  "daily_fine_sia_2024",
  "school_coverage_2024",
  "annual_primary_2024",
  "annual_primary_summary_2024",
  "annual_fine_sia_sensitivity_2024",
  "observed_day_sensitivity_summary_2024",
  "fine_episode_school_2024",
  "episode_sensitivity_fine_2024",
  "annual_sia_subtraction_summary_2024",
  "annual_context_analysis_2024",
  "context_association_results_2024"
)

missing_essential_objects <- setdiff(
  essential_object_names_2024,
  ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
)

if (length(missing_essential_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Cannot clean the environment; missing essential object(s): ",
    paste(missing_essential_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

save(
  list = essential_object_names_2024,
  file = file.path(
    processed_dir,
    "essential_analysis_objects_2024.RData" 
  )
)

rm(
  list = setdiff(
    ls(envir = .GlobalEnv),
    essential_object_names_2024
  ),
  envir = .GlobalEnv
)

invisible(gc())

cat(
  "Essential objects retained:",
  length(ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)),
  "\nCache saved to processed_data/essential_analysis_objects_2024.RData\n"
)
```
